resources.string: Skills are files in the agent\'s folder. Add one here, or import a pack.
One of Hermes\'s own skills. Hermes keeps it in step with its bundle, so it can be read, pinned and switched on or off here but not edited or deleted.

Its skills are removed from this profile, except the ones you edited, which stay as your own. Core Hub stops installing and updating them here until you switch it back on.
The whole skill folder goes, with every file in it. Turning it off keeps everything.

The plugins Hermes has in this profile, with Hermes\'s own status. One that is not enabled does not load — except the messaging platforms and model providers Hermes ships, which load when they are used. A change reaches the agent\'s next session.

A name from Hermes\'s plugin catalog, owner/repo, or a Git URL. Hermes fetches it, scans it and installs it into this profile switched off; switch it on when you are ready.
